 Follow Selena Gomez’s Candid Vaping Confession Comes With a Warning
 Chhavi Puri Mon, October 19, 2026 at 9:31 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: @selenagomez/Instagram Selena Gomez revealed that vaping nicotine has played a major role in changing her voice. The pop singer recently shared a video on her Instagram Stories that quickly caught fans' attention. In the video, she explained that she may not be able to change her voice, attributing it to her excessive nicotine vaping. She also warned others against picking up the habit, emphasizing that it is simply not worth it.
 Selena Gomez reflects on her struggles with vaping nicotine in new video
 Selena Gomez recently reflected on her struggles with nicotine vaping in an Instagram video. She shared the clip on October 18, shedding light on the effects of vaping and encouraging people to avoid the habit. She said, "I'm not going to be able to change my voice" before adding, "I vaped nicotine a lot."
 The singer also explained that quitting nicotine vaping can be extremely difficult. She added, "And I think I just wanted to say, if you're going through it or if you're even trying to vape, it's just not worth it."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Calling the habit "stupid," the "Wolves" hitmaker acknowledged that it had affected her voice. She also addressed the criticism her vocal tone has received, saying, "So if you guys don't like listening to my voice, that's totally understandable. I don't mind. Just don't listen to it," with a laugh.
 Gomez further revealed that she has quit the habit and feels genuinely happy about her decision, adding that she hopes to stay on track. She concluded , "If you are going through something, you can get through it too."
 Fans had previously speculated about changes in her vocal tone . She addressed the topic during an Instagram Live session last December, revealing that people often ask her why her voice has changed. In response, the singer explained that her throat sometimes swells internally, adding that this was the reason she had given for the change.
